summary: Fair Isaac Corp filed an 8-K on June 5, 2026, reporting entry into a credit agreement amendment for a $1.5 billion unsecured incremental term loan maturing May 15, 2028. The loan was fully drawn and proceeds will fund an accelerated share repurchase program described in Item 8.01. Interest rates are based on base rate or SOFR plus applicable margins, with quarterly principal repayments. The existing $1.0 billion revolving facility remains. This capital return structure uses debt to retire equity, reducing share count. Watch for completion of the ASR program and impact on EPS.
